Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer failed to correctly interpret the search results in Step 4. The search query included `site:thepeerage.com`, yet the visible results in the viewport (Bruno, Evrad, Frederik Willem, etc.) are clearly from a different branch of the Limburg Stirum family (modern or Dutch-German nobility from the 19th/20th centuries) and do not contain the target subject, Ferdinand Gotthard Meinrad (born ~1701). Despite the query explicitly filtering for ThePeerage, the agent did not notice that the relevant page for Ferdinand I was not in the visible viewport and instead repeated the same ineffective action in subsequent steps, failing to scroll or refine the search to actually locate the specific historical entry required to solve the problem.
